capabilities: Replaces the caret with a gliding, petal-emitting caret and celebrates word milestones with blooms
Scrolls the page so the writing line stays at a fixed height (typewriter scrolling)
Turns notes into book-styled reading pages with drop caps, running heads and reading progress
Tracks daily words, streaks, a 16-week heatmap and other writing statistics toward a daily goal
Renders Bases card views as a bookshelf with covers from a note property
extras: Warns that LoveBites and the Typewriter Mode plugin would fight over scroll position if both are enabled; states it makes no network requests and stores history locally in data.json.
intentEvidence: If you use the Typewriter Mode plugin, turn it off — LoveBites does its own typewriter scrolling
motivation: The author wants Obsidian to feel like a desk — paper, ink and ceremony — rather than a database.
problem: Obsidian's plain editor and reading view feel like a database rather than a pleasant desk for writing and reading, with no built-in typewriter scrolling or writing-history stats.

relations.evidence: If you use the Typewriter Mode plugin, turn it off — LoveBites does its own typewriter scrolling

summary: Animated writing pad that rewards word counts with petals and blooms, plus a book-styled reading mode, typewriter scrolling and writing statistics.
